title: Coefficient-Decoupled Matrix Product Operators as an Interface to Linear-Combination-of-Unitaries Circuits
summary: We introduce a coefficient-decoupled matrix product operator (MPO) representation for Pauli-sum operators that separates reusable symbolic operator support from a tunable coefficient bridge across a fixed bipartition. This representation provides a direct interface to linear-combination-of-unitaries (LCU) circuits: the symbolic left/right dictionaries define a static \textsc{Select} oracle that is compiled once, while coefficient updates modify only a dynamic \textsc{Prep} oracle.
